estrutura.personaBrief: Chavez's 1999 Constitution kept nominal federalism, but power, oil revenue and appointments were progressively centralized in the presidency and a unified party/state apparatus.

representacao.personaBrief: Chavismo claimed participatory democracy (referendums, recall, communal councils) and won repeated elections, while packing courts, the electoral council and media and ruling by enabling laws.

poder.personaBrief: A security-minded, mobilizing state with high crime, disarmament drive and tight media/surveillance controls, but no death penalty and conservative stance on drugs.

imigracao.personaBrief: Bolivarian Latin American unity and a multiethnic, Afro-mestizo and indigenous-celebrating constitution made Chavez's Venezuela open to regional migrants (Colombians regularized) with a nationalist cultural streak.

diplomacia.personaBrief: Chavez rhetorically favored peace and multipolarity but militarized society, bought Russian arms, created reserves and militias, and rejected Western-led tribunals.

intervencao.personaBrief: Officially anti-imperialist and defender of non-interference, yet Chavez used oil diplomacy (ALBA, Petrocaribe) to project regional influence and back allied governments.

economia.personaBrief: Socialism of the 21st century: nationalizations of oil, telecom, power, steel, cement and farms, expropriations, cooperatives and oil-funded Missions delivering health, food and education.

controle.personaBrief: Exchange controls (CADIVI), price controls, minimum wage increases, subordinated central bank and heavy state direction of strategic sectors, financed by oil spending.

comercio.personaBrief: Food and industrial sovereignty, expropriation of foreign assets, state purchasing preference and ALBA/Mercosur/Petrocaribe solidarity trade over free-market globalism.

religiao.personaBrief: Chavez was a nominal Catholic invoking Christ as a socialist, with God in the constitutional preamble and friction with the Church hierarchy, in a broadly religious society.

moral.personaBrief: Chavismo was socially empowering for the Afro-mestizo poor but culturally conservative on family, abortion and LGBT matters, with a patriarchal caudillo style.

tecnologia.personaBrief: A petro-state betting on oil, mining and state industrialization with Chinese and Russian technology, while banning GM seeds and blaming capitalism for climate change.
